ABSTRACT
Date of Publication:
07 July 2025
Key Terms:
Setting,
Realism,
Characterization, Character. Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined. The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements. This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings. A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling. These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels. Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study. They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits. These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on). These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits. The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars. For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell. The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions. Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery. Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it. Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there. Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development. A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work. Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work. In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work. This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS  
Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The objectives of the study were guided by the combination of two theories, namely, the theory of Realism and the theory of Structuralism. The theory of Realism emerged in the nineteenth century (Ntarangwi, 2004). The term 'uhalisia' is a translation of the English word 'realism', which was originally used to refer to a branch of philosophy concerned with matters related to human perception. Currently, this term is used to refer to two meanings: the first is one that evaluates the state of life, that is, the reality in literature which signifies the skill of composition and describes events according to objectivity; and the second meaning is the actual condition of human life. The theory of Structuralism is often associated with the Prague linguists (Mwangi, 2005). It emphasizes the elements of an artistic work such as plot, message, characters, context, language, and how these interact to complete the work in question. This theory examines the relationships among the various components of literary compositions, such as structural narrative analysis. The theory focuses on the narration of an artistic work. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other. The pillars of the theory of Structuralism include:
• Writers and critics of realism consider that the role of the author should be to depict reality as it appears in the respective society. • Any literary work has a structure that is self-sufficient in its various interconnected parts, which come together to form a single complete system (plot). • Realists believed that a writer was required to provide a complete picture of their society as it truly is, without exaggerating or diminishing it. • Structuralists explain that particular functions of literature should be considered, for example, the use of language targeting the individual and that depend on the rules of the literary language system and language in general. Therefore, the first principle of Structuralism helped us identify how settings contribute to bringing out key elements of the plot as well as the traits of various characters in the selected novels analyzed. Riwaya hizi zilichaguliwa kulingana na wingi wa mambo yanayochunguzwa, yaani uelekezaji wa mazingira. Mbali na kuakisi malengo ya utafiti, muundo wa riwaya zilizochaguliwa unaendana na mkabala wa nadharia zilizochanganywa. UTANGULIZI  
Kazi ya fasihi inajengwa kwa kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya kisanii, ikiwa ni pamoja na matumizi ya mandhari. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia katika uundaji na uwasilishaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Mandhari mara nyingi hutumiwa na mwandishi kufikisha ujumbe wao kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha mandhari kimeelezewa na wasomi mbalimbali. Kwa mfano, Wamitila (2008) anafafanua mahali na wakati kama kipengele kinachoonyesha kwa msomaji mahali na wakati ambapo matukio fulani yalifanyika. Mandhari zinaweza kuwa halisi au za kubuni. Mandhari halisi zinahusu maeneo yaliyopo katika dunia halisi. Kwa mfano, mandhari kama vile msituni, chuo kikuu, nyumbani, ofisini, mjini, na katika maeneo ya ibada. Mandhari za kubuni zinahusu mazingira ya ajabu na mengi hukutana kupitia ndoto. Mifano ya mandhari za kubuni ni pamoja na peponi, kuzimu, na jahanamu. Mandhari inayoonyeshwa kwa msomaji hubaki akilini mwao. Waandishi wengi, wanapoandika kazi zao, huziweka katika mandhari mbalimbali ili kutimiza madhumuni tofauti ya kifasihi na kisanii. Kwa hivyo ni sahihi kusema kwamba mandhari ni nguzo kuu katika uundaji wa kazi za kisanii. Mandhari inaathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa aina mbalimbali za picha za kile mwandishi alikusudia kuwasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Picha hizi zinaweza kuwa, kwa mfano: taswira ya kuona, ambayo humwezesha msomaji 'kuona' kile mwandishi anaonyesha kupitia maneno; taswira ya mwendo, ambayo humsaidia msomaji kupata uzoefu wa tukio 'linalotokea' kulingana na mandhari tukio linapotokea; taswira ya hisia, ambapo msomaji anapitia hisia mbalimbali za wahusika ndani ya muktadha huku mwandishi akichunguza hisia hizo; taswira ya ladha, ambayo msomaji anaipata katika mandhari ambapo vitendo husababisha msukumo wa kutokwa mate; na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira ya sauti. Kwa kuchukua mfano wa eneo la Selea, linaloonekana katika riwaya ya *Kiu*, mwandishi anatuambia kwamba lilikuwa mahali (mazingira) palipojulikana kwa umaskini mkubwa na matatizo mengi; wakaazi waliishi katika vibanda na wengine kwenye vyumba vilivyopakwa udongo, na barabara ya kufika huko ilikuwa mbaya kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi lisingeweza kufika. Wahusika kama Bahati na mama yake Chausiku, ambao waliishi katika mtaa huu, nao pia walikuwa maskini. Hii ina maana kwamba mazingira yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa wahusika hawa na tabia zao. Walikuwa maskini, ndiyo maana waliishi hapo. Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mpangilio wa hadithi humjulisha msomaji kuhusu safari ya mhusika kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho wa hadithi. Hivyo basi, msomaji anaelewa mhusika katika kila mahali na katika kila hatua ya maendeleo yao. Mfano mzuri ni mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu katika riwaya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ambaye tunasimuliwa kuhusu utoto wake, masomo yake ughaibuni, kushiriki kwake katika ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria masomo yake katika shule ya Nasaba Bora, kufukuzwa kazini na kupata kazi nyingine, kuhusika katika wizi wa miswada ya waandishi, na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara alipoalikwa Wangwani. Hapa, tunapewa sifa kadhaa za mhusika huyu kupitia mazingira mbalimbali—kwamba alikuwa msomi, mlevi, mwizi wa taaluma, na mzembe kazini mwake. Sifa za tabia mara nyingi husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Sifa hizi mara nyingi hufichua tabia zao, mwenendo, au hata haiba zao ndani ya kazi ya fasihi husika. Kwa maana hii, mandhari ina jukumu muhimu katika kuonyesha tabia za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi kikubwa, wahusika huathiriwa na mandhari wanakoonyeshwa. Baadhi ya kazi za fasihi zinaonyesha mandhari ya umasikini, matatizo mengi, na wahusika wanaoishi katika mabanda na vyumba vya kupakwa matope, pamoja na usafiri unaotegemea barabara mbovu. Hii inamaanisha kwamba mandhari inayochorwa na msanii ina athari ya moja kwa moja katika uundaji wa tabia za wahusika katika kazi husika. Hili ndilo suala lililochunguzwa katika utafiti uliozaa makala hii. Lengo kuu lilikuwa kuchunguza namna mazingira yalivyoportraywa katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ili kubainisha uhusiano kati ya mazingira na sifa za wahusika. Kupitia tathmini, hoja inayotolewa na makala hii ni kwamba mazingira ambayo wahusika wanajikuta ndani yake katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* yanachangia katika kujengwa kwa sifa zao. Imebainika kuwa mazingira pia yanaathiri namna baadhi ya wahusika wanavyoportraywa. Mazingira yana jukumu kubwa katika kuwapa wahusika sifa maalumu (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika anajikuta vinatoa ishara na vinaathiri namna sifa zao zinavyoportraywa. Kwa hiyo, makala hii inachunguza uhusiano baina ya mazingira na sifa za wahusika katika kazi hizi mbili na inadhihirisha waziwazi kuwepo kwa uhusiano huu pamoja na jinsi waandishi hawa walivyowaonyesha wahusika wao.

MTINDO WA UANDISHI
Wamitila (2002) anasema kuwa mazingira yana mchango mkubwa katika uonyeshaji wa sifa za wahusika. Anaeleza kuwa wahusika wanaathiriwa sana na mazingira yao. Kauli hii ya Wamitila ilijitokeza katika utafiti huu. Ili kuonyesha mhusika kwa namna fulani, ni muhimu kuchunguza mazingira anamoishi (Wamitila, 2008). MSINGI WA KINADHARIA  
Kupitia nguzo ya pili ya nadharia ya Uhalisia, utafiti huu ulichunguza jinsi waandishi wa vitabu hivi vilivyochaguliwa walivyowakilisha uhalisia katika kazi zao kupitia mazingira mbalimbali waliyotumia. Hii ilituruhusu kubaini baadhi ya tabia za wahusika tofauti na hivyo kutusaidia kutimiza lengo la utafiti huu, ambalo ni kutathmini mchango wa mazingira katika kujenga tabia za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Malengo ya utafiti yaliongozwa na muunganiko wa nadharia mbili, yaani, nadharia ya Uhalisia na nadharia ya Uundaji. Nadharia ya Uhalisia ilitokea katika karne ya kumi na tisa (Ntarangwi, 2004). Neno 'uhalisia' ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza 'realism', ambalo awali lilitumika kurejelea tawi la falsafa linaloshughulika na masuala yanayohusiana na mtazamo wa kibinadamu. Kwa sasa, neno hili linatumika kurejelea maana mbili: ya kwanza ni ile inayopima hali ya maisha, yaani, uhalisia katika fasihi unaomaanisha ustadi wa uandishi na kuelezea matukio kwa mujibu wa ukweli; na maana ya pili ni hali halisi ya maisha ya binadamu. Nadharia ya Ustrukturalisti mara nyingi inahusishwa na wanaisimu wa Prague (Mwangi, 2005). Inasisitiza vipengele vya kazi ya kisanii kama vile mpangilio, ujumbe, wahusika, muktadha, lugha, na jinsi vipengele hivi vinavyoshirikiana kukamilisha kazi husika. Nadharia hii inachunguza uhusiano kati ya sehemu mbalimbali za utunzi wa fasihi, kama vile uchambuzi wa kimuundo wa masimulizi. Nadharia hii inazingatia usimulizi wa kazi ya kisanii. Kwa mfano, uchambuzi wa kimuundo wa riwaya huzingatia riwaya kama kazi iliyo na muundo wake kamili ikiwa na vipengele kama mpangilio, wahusika, na mbinu mbalimbali za usimulizi ambazo zinaingiliana na kutegemeana. MBINU ZA UTAFITI  
Data za utafiti kwa ajili ya utafiti huu zilichambuliwa kwa kuzingatia maudhui ili kubaini aina mbalimbali za mazingira katika riwaya zilizochaguliwa na mchango wake katika kukuza tabia za wahusika tofauti katika riwaya hizi. Baada ya uchambuzi wa data, matokeo ya utafiti yamewasilishwa kwa njia ya maelezo. Uchambuzi wenyewe ulifanyika kulingana na malengo na mifumo ya nadharia iliyouongoza uchunguzi. Maelezo ni mbinu ya uchambuzi ambayo humwezesha mtafiti kusoma au kusikiliza kazi ya fasihi, kuelewa dhamira zake, mitazamo ya kifalsafa ya kazi husika, pamoja na mambo mengine muhimu (Adam, 2014). Mandhari ina jukumu kubwa katika kuunda tabia fulani za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiwango fulani, mahali na wakati ambao mhusika anajikuta vinaashiria na kuathiri uwasilishaji wa sifa zao. Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulitegemea muundo wa utafiti wa uchambuzi. Utafiti wa uchambuzi huchunguza vigezo kwa undani ili kufikia hitimisho linalofaa (Read, 1987). Mfumo huu ulituwezesha kukusanya, kuchambua, na kuelezea matokeo kulingana na matokeo ya utafiti huu, hivyo kutusaidia kufikia hitimisho linalofaa. Mbili kati ya riwaya 10 za uhalisia zilizolengwa zilichaguliwa kwa makusudi. Hii ni sampuli ya makusudi, ambapo sampuli huchaguliwa kwa misingi ya kuwa na sifa za kipekee zinazohitajika katika utafiti. Sampuli ya makusudi mara nyingi inahusisha uteuzi wa kundi linalowakilisha la wahusika, vitu, au dhana ambazo zinaendana na vigezo vinavyofanyiwa uchunguzi (Kombo & Tromp, 2006). Kwa hiyo, riwaya zilizochaguliwa ziliendana na malengo na mifumo ya kinadharia ya utafiti, na ndiyo sababu zilichaguliwa makusudi kwa lengo hilo. Tabia za wahusika husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi zaidi; tabia hizi mara nyingi huonyesha mwelekeo, mienendo, au hata hali ya mhusika katika kazi husika ya fasihi. Kwa mfano, katika *Kiu*, mazingira ya nyumbani mwa Mzee Mwinyi yameonyeshwa kwa namna kwamba chumba chake kilikuwa na zulia na pambo la thamani. Zaidi ya hayo, alikuwa na umiliki wa Mercedes Benz, jambo linaloonyesha kwamba alikuwa na utajiri mkubwa na hivyo alikuwa tajiri mkubwa. Sehemu ndogo zifuatazo zimetumika kuchambua na kujadili kila riwaya moja moja, kuanzia na uundaji wa sifa za wahusika katika *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Takwimu za msingi za utafiti zilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa riwaya iliyochaguliwa. Usomaji wa kina unahusisha mikakati kama vile kupigia mstari maneno yasiyofahamika, kuweka alama kwenye mambo muhimu, kuandika maoni yaliyopatikana kutokana na usomaji, kuandika maswali, kuchunguza uhusiano au mwingiliano ndani ya maandishi, pamoja na nafasi ya msimulizi (Rief, 2012). Riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* zilichambuliwa na kufasiriwa ili kufikia malengo ya utafiti. Zaidi ya hayo, makala, majarida, tasnifu na machapisho mengine yanayohusiana na mada ya utafiti yalisomwa na kuchangia katika upatikanaji wa data za sekondari. Mandhari ina jukumu kubwa katika kukuza tabia za wahusika, kwani jinsi mwandishi anavyoyachora mazingira husaidia msomaji kuelewa mengi kuhusu tabia, mwenendo, na hata hali ya wahusika katika kazi zinazowasilishwa na waandishi husika. discourses.source_txt: Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari hufafanuliwa kama wakati na mahali ambapo matukio, visa, au matendo hutokea katika kazi fulani ya fasihi. Mandhari inaweza kuwa halisi au ya kufikirika.

discourses.source_txt: The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.
discourses.translated_txt: Utafiti uliotoa taarifa kwa makala hii ulilenga kuchunguza uwasilishaji wa mandhari katika riwaya ya Mohamed S. Mohamed *Kiu* na riwaya ya Ken Walibora *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Ingawa utafiti ulikuwa na malengo matatu mahususi, makala hii inazingatia lengo moja tu—kuchanganua mchango wa mandhari katika uundaji wa tabia za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.

discourses.source_txt: The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements.
discourses.translated_txt: Tathmini yenyewe inategemea mchanganyiko wa nadharia mbili—Uhalisia na Uundo. Nadharia ya Uhalisia inachunguza ukweli wa mazingira ya kijamii, ilhali Uundole inasisitiza kazi na uhusiano wa vipengele vya kisanii.

discourses.source_txt: This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings.
discourses.translated_txt: Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulifanywa katika maktaba, ukitumia muundo wa uchanganuzi. Eneo la utafiti ni fasihi andishi, hasa tanzu ya riwaya ya Kiswahili. Walengwa wa utafiti huu ni riwaya 10 za uhalisia zinazoonyesha mazingira halisi.

discourses.source_txt: A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfano wa riwaya mbili, *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ulichaguliwa kupitia sampuli ya kimaksudi.

discourses.source_txt: These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels.
discourses.translated_txt: Riwaya hizi zilichaguliwa kulingana na wingi wa mambo yanayochunguzwa, yaani uelekezaji wa mazingira. Mbali na kuakisi malengo ya utafiti, muundo wa riwaya zilizochaguliwa unaendana na mkabala wa nadharia zilizochanganywa. Data kuu ya utafiti ilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa maandishi ya riwaya zilizochaguliwa.

discourses.source_txt: Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study.
discourses.translated_txt: Data sekondari zilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa vitabu, tasnifu, na makala mbalimbali za kitaaluma. Data zilizokusanywa ziliorodheshwa kulingana na mifumo ya nadharia na malengo ya utafiti.

discourses.source_txt: They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits.
discourses.translated_txt: Zilichambuliwa kulingana na maudhui yao na matokeo kuwasilishwa kwa njia ya maelezo. Matokeo ya utafiti yanaonyesha kwamba mipangilio ina mchango wa moja kwa moja katika ukuzaji wa tabia za wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on).
discourses.translated_txt: Mipangilio hii inajumuisha: mipangilio ya mahali (kama vile kingo za Mto Kiberenge, chumba cha Chifu Nasaba Bora, msitu, selo, chumba cha Mzee Mwinyi, na maeneo kama vile Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, na mengineyo) na mipangilio ya wakati (enzi ya ukoloni, vipindi vya miaka mitano, Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, na kadhalika).

discourses.source_txt: These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits.
discourses.translated_txt: Mipangilio hii iliundwa kwa ustadi kwa njia ambayo ilirahisisha sana ukuzaji wa tabia za wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. Furthermore, literary critics will be enabled to identify and evaluate various settings along with their roles in literary works.

discourses.source_txt:
INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars.
discourses.translated_txt:
UTANGULIZI  
Kazi ya fasihi inajengwa kwa kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya kisanii, ikiwa ni pamoja na matumizi ya mandhari. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia katika uundaji na uwasilishaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Mandhari mara nyingi hutumiwa na mwandishi kufikisha ujumbe wao kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha mandhari kimeelezewa na wasomi mbalimbali.

discourses.source_txt: For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa mfano, Wamitila (2008) anafafanua mahali na wakati kama kipengele kinachoonyesha kwa msomaji mahali na wakati ambapo matukio fulani yalifanyika. Mandhari zinaweza kuwa halisi au za kubuni. Mandhari halisi zinahusu maeneo yaliyopo katika dunia halisi. Kwa mfano, mandhari kama vile msituni, chuo kikuu, nyumbani, ofisini, mjini, na katika maeneo ya ibada. Mandhari za kubuni zinahusu mazingira ya ajabu na mengi hukutana kupitia ndoto. Mifano ya mandhari za kubuni ni pamoja na peponi, kuzimu, na jahanamu.

discourses.source_txt: The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari inayoonyeshwa kwa msomaji hubaki akilini mwao. Waandishi wengi, wanapoandika kazi zao, huziweka katika mandhari mbalimbali ili kutimiza madhumuni tofauti ya kifasihi na kisanii. Kwa hivyo ni sahihi kusema kwamba mandhari ni nguzo kuu katika uundaji wa kazi za kisanii.

discourses.source_txt: Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari inaathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa aina mbalimbali za picha za kile mwandishi alikusudia kuwasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Picha hizi zinaweza kuwa, kwa mfano: taswira ya kuona, ambayo humwezesha msomaji 'kuona' kile mwandishi anaonyesha kupitia maneno; taswira ya mwendo, ambayo humsaidia msomaji kupata uzoefu wa tukio 'linalotokea' kulingana na mandhari tukio linapotokea; taswira ya hisia, ambapo msomaji anapitia hisia mbalimbali za wahusika ndani ya muktadha huku mwandishi akichunguza hisia hizo; taswira ya ladha, ambayo msomaji anaipata katika mandhari ambapo vitendo husababisha msukumo wa kutokwa mate; na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira ya sauti.

discourses.source_txt: Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuchukua mfano wa eneo la Selea, linaloonekana katika riwaya ya *Kiu*, mwandishi anatuambia kwamba lilikuwa mahali (mazingira) palipojulikana kwa umaskini mkubwa na matatizo mengi; wakaazi waliishi katika vibanda na wengine kwenye vyumba vilivyopakwa udongo, na barabara ya kufika huko ilikuwa mbaya kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi lisingeweza kufika.

discourses.source_txt: Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there.
discourses.translated_txt: Wahusika kama Bahati na mama yake Chausiku, ambao waliishi katika mtaa huu, nao pia walikuwa maskini. Hii ina maana kwamba mazingira yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa wahusika hawa na tabia zao. Walikuwa maskini, ndiyo maana waliishi hapo.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development.
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mpangilio wa hadithi humjulisha msomaji kuhusu safari ya mhusika kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho wa hadithi. Hivyo basi, msomaji anaelewa mhusika katika kila mahali na katika kila hatua ya maendeleo yao.

discourses.source_txt: A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfano mzuri ni mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu katika riwaya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ambaye tunasimuliwa kuhusu utoto wake, masomo yake ughaibuni, kushiriki kwake katika ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria masomo yake katika shule ya Nasaba Bora, kufukuzwa kazini na kupata kazi nyingine, kuhusika katika wizi wa miswada ya waandishi, na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara alipoalikwa Wangwani. Hapa, tunapewa sifa kadhaa za mhusika huyu kupitia mazingira mbalimbali—kwamba alikuwa msomi, mlevi, mwizi wa taaluma, na mzembe kazini mwake.

discourses.source_txt: Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work.
discourses.translated_txt: Sifa za tabia mara nyingi husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Sifa hizi mara nyingi hufichua tabia zao, mwenendo, au hata haiba zao ndani ya kazi ya fasihi husika.

discourses.source_txt: In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa maana hii, mandhari ina jukumu muhimu katika kuonyesha tabia za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi kikubwa, wahusika huathiriwa na mandhari wanakoonyeshwa. Baadhi ya kazi za fasihi zinaonyesha mandhari ya umasikini, matatizo mengi, na wahusika wanaoishi katika mabanda na vyumba vya kupakwa matope, pamoja na usafiri unaotegemea barabara mbovu. Hii inamaanisha kwamba mandhari inayochorwa na msanii ina athari ya moja kwa moja katika uundaji wa tabia za wahusika katika kazi husika.

discourses.source_txt:
This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

WRITING STYLE
Wamitila (2002) states that setting makes substantial contributions to the depiction of character traits. He explains that characters are largely influenced by their surroundings. This assertion by Wamitila emerged in this research. In order to depict a character in a particular way, it is essential to examine the setting in which they are found (Wamitila, 2008).
discourses.translated_txt:
Hili ndilo suala lililochunguzwa katika utafiti uliozaa makala hii. Lengo kuu lilikuwa kuchunguza namna mazingira yalivyoportraywa katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ili kubainisha uhusiano kati ya mazingira na sifa za wahusika. Kupitia tathmini, hoja inayotolewa na makala hii ni kwamba mazingira ambayo wahusika wanajikuta ndani yake katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* yanachangia katika kujengwa kwa sifa zao. Imebainika kuwa mazingira pia yanaathiri namna baadhi ya wahusika wanavyoportraywa. Mazingira yana jukumu kubwa katika kuwapa wahusika sifa maalumu (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika anajikuta vinatoa ishara na vinaathiri namna sifa zao zinavyoportraywa. Kwa hiyo, makala hii inachunguza uhusiano baina ya mazingira na sifa za wahusika katika kazi hizi mbili na inadhihirisha waziwazi kuwepo kwa uhusiano huu pamoja na jinsi waandishi hawa walivyowaonyesha wahusika wao.

MTINDO WA UANDISHI
Wamitila (2002) anasema kuwa mazingira yana mchango mkubwa katika uonyeshaji wa sifa za wahusika. Anaeleza kuwa wahusika wanaathiriwa sana na mazingira yao. Kauli hii ya Wamitila ilijitokeza katika utafiti huu. Ili kuonyesha mhusika kwa namna fulani, ni muhimu kuchunguza mazingira anamoishi (Wamitila, 2008).

discourses.source_txt: This claim was affirmed by this research when the character Majununi was examined in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. We found that this character was used by the author to inform us about a specific historical period, which is the Second World War, and that Majununi was among the British soldiers who fought in this war. Many people died on the battlefield, but he survived.
discourses.translated_txt: Madai haya yalithibitishwa na utafiti huu wakati mhusika Majununi alipochunguzwa katika riwaya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Tuligundua kuwa mhusika huyu alitumiwa na mwandishi kutufahamisha kuhusu kipindi maalum cha kihistoria, ambacho ni Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, na kwamba Majununi alikuwa miongoni mwa askari Waingereza waliopigana katika vita hivi. Watu wengi walikufa vitani, lakini yeye alinusurika.

discourses.source_txt: Therefore, as Wamitila (2008) states, every character acquires traits that align with the setting they are in—this claim is true and helped answer the research question that setting contributes to the development of characters' traits.

discourses.source_txt: • Realists recognized the role of the writer who adheres to realism by selecting, analyzing, and differentiating the subjects they wish to address in order to portray reality as it truly exists in society. Therefore, when we examine some of these scholars' definitions, we find that they focused on the setting of place and time in their explanations. These definitions made a significant contribution to this study because the research itself examined setting based on the notion that setting is the time and place where artistic events occur.

Hivyo basi, tunapochunguza baadhi ya tafsiri za wasomi hawa, tunagundua kuwa walilenga mazingira ya mahali na wakati katika maelezo yao. THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS  
Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.

Hii ilituruhusu kubaini baadhi ya tabia za wahusika tofauti na hivyo kutusaidia kutimiza lengo la utafiti huu, ambalo ni kutathmini mchango wa mazingira katika kujenga tabia za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.

discourses.source_txt: The theory of Structuralism is often associated with the Prague linguists (Mwangi, 2005). This theory examines the relationships among the various components of literary compositions, such as structural narrative analysis. The theory focuses on the narration of an artistic work. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other.
discourses.translated_txt: Nadharia ya Ustrukturalisti mara nyingi inahusishwa na wanaisimu wa Prague (Mwangi, 2005). When five years have passed in the marriage, Idi’s antics begin. He would hire workers and dismiss them arbitrarily. One day, when he wanted to fire one of those workers, he is heard saying,
“Five years have passed ... and five years is not a short time for a person whose every moment of life is filled with all sorts of antics.” (Kiu pp. 94–95)
“I have suffered for many years; I will not allow myself to be troubled by a mere cat like you!” (Kiu p. 97)
By hiring and dismissing his workers so capriciously, Idi is revealed as impatient, ungrateful, and lacking in perseverance.
